contexts.statement: Review the existing Family 032 Argus mathematical drafts indexed from PRIOR_DRAFTS.json, not a new manuscript-error search. Separate ordinary-geometric claims, exact algebraic evidence, imported results and incomplete formal replay; native independent Reviewer acceptance is required.

definitions.ordinary_CM: An ordinary complex abelian variety whose actual rational Hodge group on H^1 is a torus, including the point.
definitions.supply_families: Complex abelian varieties with a unital imaginary-quadratic action: dimension at most five, or dimension six with an actual compatible rational homological Hermitian polarization hyperbolic of signature (3,3).
definitions.CM_supply: Images of full rational cohomology of CM abelian varieties under finite sums of rational algebraic correspondences and Tate shifts; a rational Hodge lift is not an algebraic cycle.
definitions.known_failed_route: Historical AG-GENERIC-SUBSTITUTION is retired: a generic PEL group does not determine actual images at every special period, and derived self-duality at a partially pure column is not an all-conjugate Hodge pairing. It is not reopened.
definitions.evidence_boundary: Engineer prose assessments and historical reviewer judgements are not current native acceptance or Lean kernel evidence; source text is not an elaborated theorem or an axiom report.

claims.natural_statement: For every complex abelian variety A of dimension at most six with a unital imaginary-quadratic action, its actual derived Hodge-group images on non-CM Albert columns are the full independent classical groups in the reviewed small-column list, after admissible matrix-copy identifications and pairing opposite CM embeddings. This is condition (c), not a full reductive-group, determinant-supply or Hodge-algebraicity theorem.

For every A in supply_families, every m>=1 and p>=0, each rational Hodge class in H^{2p}(A^m,Q) lies in CM_supply and has a rational Hodge lift through finitely many of its defining CM-source correspondence maps. Algebraicity requires the separate ordinary CM Hodge input; arbitrary additional CM companions are not asserted.

Every ordinary CM source, including a point, satisfies the HasComplexMultiplication and geometric domain hypotheses in the pinned openai/math MainSolution CM declaration; its coefficient-filtered Hodge classes and component cycle-class spans have the ordinary geometric meanings needed by REUSE-DS.

The exact MainSolution.hodge_conjecture_for_cm_abelian_varieties declaration at openai/math commit 4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae has a completed source-bound Lean 4.34.1 replay with its declared Mathlib pin, an elaborated statement, and no proof holes or mathematical axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
The pinned MainSolution CM theorem validly discharges the ordinary rational CM Hodge algebraicity input for all CM sources and codimensions occurring in REUSE-DS.

Assuming REUSE-DS and the ordinary rational Hodge conjecture for every CM abelian variety in every codimension, every rational Hodge class on every self-power of every A in supply_families is algebraic; the proof composes algebraic source cycles with the supplied correspondences, with codimension (p-j)+(dim B+j)-dim B=p.
